collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A villager presses a row of thumbprints around the rim of a wet clay bowl.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (name1) presses a row of thumbprints around the rim of a wet clay bowl. A child adds one tiny thumbprint beside the others, and it stays.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (name1) presses a row of thumbprints around the rim of a wet clay bowl. (name1) decides the bowl is too pretty to use and sets it on a shelf.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (name1) presses a row of thumbprints around the rim of a wet clay bowl. The bowl cracks in the kiln, but the thumbprints survive on the largest piece.

e1__fx.name: Ending 1
e1__fx.text: (name1) presses a row of thumbprints around the rim of a wet clay bowl. The pattern comes out of the fire looking even better than (name1) hoped.
